worldcombat.skill.howl.summary: Raises its head and howls, boosting the Attack of the user and nearby allies; the cry echoes for a while, and the boost is taken back when the rally fades.
worldcombat.skill.howl.use.0: Raise the whole team's Attack before a fight
worldcombat.skill.howl.use.1: Rouse allies who step into the cry later
worldcombat.skill.howl.use.2: Solo, pour all the spirit into two Attack stages
worldcombat.skill.howl.description.0: The howl raises Attack by %1$s stage: the pack cry rouses the user and every friendly ally within %2$s blocks, while the solo cry covers only a small circle around the user; enemies are unaffected.
worldcombat.skill.howl.description.1: The rally lasts about %1$s s on the user and each roused ally; the cry echoes outward every 20 ticks, so allies who step into the radius later are roused too (those already roused gain no further stages). The boost is taken back when the window ends or is cleared.
worldcombat.skill.howl.cry.pack: Pack: +1 stage for the user and each ally in radius, wide and long, at +1 tick wind-up and x1.1 cooldown — each one gains less.
worldcombat.skill.howl.cry.solo: Solo: +2 stages for the user, a much smaller radius (a tight circle around the user), -1 tick wind-up and x0.9 cooldown.
worldcombat.skill.howl.timing: Self move, covering a %1$s block radius; after %2$s s of telegraph it costs %4$s PP to fire, then %3$s s recovery and %5$s s cooldown from commit.
worldcombat.skill.howl.preference.cry.he: Pack: +1 stage for the user and each ally in radius, wide, long, +1 tick wind-up, x1.1 cooldown, each one gains less - good for leading a team. Solo: +2 stages for the user, a much smaller radius and a shorter window, -1 tick wind-up, x0.9 cooldown - good for fighting alone.
worldcombat.skill.howl.preference.ai.max: Consider howling first only while a threat is this close; larger rallies earlier.
worldcombat.skill.howl.preference.ai.min: Closer than this the partner stops prioritising the rally and fights directly; larger gives the rally up in melee more often.
worldcombat.skill.howl.growth.0: From level %1$s: rally duration design value %2$s.
worldcombat.skill.howl.growth.1: From level %1$s: rally duration design value %2$s.
